confucius.name: Confucius
confucius.intro:
Confucius taught the joy of learning and the importance of treating others well.
His idea of ren is about growing a caring, humane heart.

laozi.name: Laozi
laozi.intro:
Laozi invites us to stop forcing things and notice the flow of nature.
He shows how gentleness and humility can last longer than force.

sunzi.name: Sun Tzu
sunzi.intro:
Sun Tzu teaches us to understand a situation before taking action.
His lessons explore preparation, flexibility and avoiding needless conflict.
